title: Azure Pill Blocks Grow Your Business Template
whatItIs: A stock-template preview of a square post on navy and pale grey with a large white card carrying a heavy navy headline 'Grow Your Business' and a paragraph, an azure vertical pill at the left, an azure block at the top and a column at the right of outlined arcs and a circle.
whatItMeans: Solid azure pills against fine outlined shapes create contrast between weight and lightness.
techniques: Solid pill and outline shapes in one composition
Heavy navy headline over light body text
Fine-line geometric column on the right

vocabulary.definition: A white card placed over background shapes.
Mixing filled and outlined shapes for contrast.
A capsule standing on its end used as a shape.
